name: touchline-matchday
description: Touchline Matchday — protótipo local da tela de partida

scripts.dev: npm run verify:onboarding-code && npm run sync:onboarding-assets && vite --host 0.0.0.0 --open
scripts.dev:offline: npm run verify:onboarding-code && npm run sync:onboarding-assets:force && vite --host 0.0.0.0 --open
scripts.build: npm run verify:onboarding-code && npm run sync:onboarding-assets && vite build
scripts.verify:onboarding-code: node --check src/career-onboarding-local-pack.js && node --check src/career-onboarding-v9-asset-integrity.js && node --check scripts/sync-onboarding-assets-v3.mjs && node --check scripts/sync-onboarding-manager-assets.mjs
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && node tests/ui-dom-smoke.mjs 1366 768 && node tests/ui-dom-smoke.mjs 1440 900
